name: Innovative Tech Pack Limited
about: Innovative Tech Pack Limited engages in the manufacture and resale of plastic bottles, jars, containers, and pre-forms and caps in India. The company's products are used in the packaging of oils, liquor, medicinal syrups, sauces, insect repellents, honey, energy powders, candies, biscuits, mayonnaise, and dairy-based beverages. It serves the food and beverage, dairy, pharmaceutical, consumer goods, cosmetics, confectionary, and registered design industries. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Noida, India.
